# apipbx_paging_group (Resource)

A paging group: dialling its number pages the idle members, whose phones answer by themselves. Import with "<tenant id>/<id>".



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (List of String) Extension ids.
- `name` (String)
- `number` (String) Dialable; shares the number space with extensions, ring groups, queues and conferences.
- `tenant_id` (String)

### Optional

- `duplex` (Boolean) Members can talk back.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
